record.issue_text: [Medium/bug] handleNewBooking.ts:1098 — `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` silently does nothing when `destinationCalendar` is null, dropping team members' destination calendars instead of initializing the array

adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Immediately after, for collective team events the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, which will no-op when `destinationCalendar` is `null`. Since `teamDestinationCalendars` can be populated from other team members even when the organizer/eventType has no destination calendar, this silently drops those calendars instead of initializing the array.
